name: sphica
description: Records Claude Code and Codex sessions on your machine and keeps past implementation and decisions, with their sources, for your agent to find.

review_commands.title: Review commands
review_commands.description: Your own review commands whose names do not contain "review", comma-separated. Each gets the decisions your local change touches. When empty, SPHICA_REVIEW_COMMANDS is used

auto_trace.title: Automatic trace
auto_trace.description: At the start of a new session, ask the agent to trace earlier sessions that wait to be traced. SPHICA_AUTO_TRACE=off keeps it off either way
